parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `RadioPlayerTests.pauseStopsPlayback` (line 160) and `RadioPlayerTests.pauseResetsStream` (line 181) — carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. Although the two test methods share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.7778), they are distinct behavioural assertions: one verifies that pause stops playback and the other verifies that pause resets the stream. Merging or extracting them would obscure test intent and couple unrelated failure modes. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where any participating record is a test fixture must default to no-action.
